audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicts the already-audited mirror (kennen__warwick), which set Level 1 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Warwick, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Skill, 2+ items = Warwick, with levels 2-3 staying Kennen. This page has Kennen on every row except a Skill at level 6.
audit.why: The two directions must agree or mirror-fix.js overwrites them; a chart of Kennen-on-everything also disagrees with the 52.45% winrate.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped to match the mirror on both layers as one atomic group, ratings and the affected whys rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 window is written as Warwick's kill window on the strength of interrupting Slicing Maelstrom.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom carries no channel flag in Riot's text — it summons a storm that strikes nearby champions, 120s at every rank. His real spike at 6 is that R adds marks toward the passive stun while your Infinite Duress is a 110s leap that his stun can cancel.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as Kennen's window; Q's 4s cooldown at rank 5 used as the concrete bait target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Infinite Duress called a 'point-and-click fight starter' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late, and spikes[1].text claims it 'eats his Slicing Maelstrom channel'.
audit.why: Warwick leaps in a direction and suppresses the FIRST champion he collides with for 1.5s, and the kit flags it as an interruptible channel — Kennen's third Mark of the Storm stun therefore threatens your ult, not the other way round. Mark of the Storm stuns after three applications from any of Q, W, E or R.
audit.corrected: R restated as a directional leap whose channel his mark stun can cancel; the sequencing is now leap after he has spent marks, not into them.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 read even as you look for a gap-close window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours once you land Q inside his poke.

edits.before: At 6 your R suppresses his Maelstrom channel for a kill.
edits.after: At 6 Slicing Maelstrom plus a mark stun beats your leap.

edits.before: With first item Kennen's stun-lock and R burst overpower you.
edits.after: First item is even: his stun-lock against your %HP bite.

edits.before: Late, ranged burst and self-peel keep Kennen safe from your dive.
edits.after: Late, two items of %max-health bite kill him once you close.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom adds marks, and the third Mark of the Storm stun cancels Infinite Duress mid-leap. Give him 6 and take the levels either side of it.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Kennen carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion in its path for 1.5s, and his mark stun cancels the channel — engage after his marks are spent. Kennen carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Your R Infinite Duress suppresses him and eats his Slicing Maelstrom channel if you ult first, so with jungle help level 6 is your best kill window before he gets Zhonya's.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion it collides with for 1.5s, and his third Mark of the Storm stun cancels that channel — leap only after he has spent Thundering Shuriken (4s at rank 5).

edits.before: Late, Kennen's ranged burst, R stun-lock, and self-peel keep you permanently out of range, so only dive him with a cleanse or jungle CC and otherwise shove and roam.
edits.after: Late, his mark stuns and R burst punish a sloppy approach, but two items of %max-health bite kill him the moment you close — engage out of fog or off jungle CC, never through the poke.

notes: diff reads FAV while diffRating is 7.5/10, breakdown.difficulty says 7.5/10 and report[14] says 'Tricky' — the FAV token is the odd one out, but the mirror auditor recorded that this matchup's tone/diff tokens are already inconsistent in the repo and had no verified palette value, so I left diff and tone alone rather than change one half of a pair I cannot verify. spikes[3].text still describes late Kennen as keeping you off him; it now sits beside a 2+ items row that reads Warwick per the mirror. I rewrote the `late` prose to hold both truths but did not touch spikes[3].text, which is the remaining soft conflict.
